question: What harmful effects are inflicted on an enemy by oblations with black gram or beleric seeds?
premises: Black gram oblation makes the enemy mute.
Beleric seed oblation makes the enemy mad.
inference: Black gram oblation silences an enemy, while beleric seed oblation maddens him.
uncertainties: akṣa may refer to Terminalia belerica seeds in ritual context.
plain_english: By oblation with black gram the enemy becomes mute; by beleric seeds the enemy becomes mad.
